intro.heading: Built Around People. Connected by Care. Driven by Excellence.
text: Founded in 2012, Cambridge Hospital has spent over fourteen years building what no other provider in the Gulf has matched: a fully integrated, dual-accredited clinical network across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Our network supports patients through the full continuum of post-acute care, long-term care and rehabilitation, from the first day of recovery through active treatment, long-term management, community reintegration and home-based support.

Today, our six purpose-built facilities and more than 715 beds bring together multidisciplinary teams and specialist expertise to care for patients with complex neurological conditions, long-term ventilation needs, post-surgical rehabilitation requirements and other medically complex conditions that require ongoing clinical support.

Our approach goes beyond treating a diagnosis. We look at the patient as a whole, taking into account their health, abilities, families and future goals. By connecting different disciplines and settings of care, we help patients and families navigate their journey with greater continuity, confidence and support.

foundation.heading: Our Foundation of Care
foundation.text: Everything we do is guided by a clear purpose, a strong vision and a shared set of values that shape every patient experience and clinical outcome.

blocks.text: To enhance quality of life by adopting best practices, creating stakeholder value and expanding access to care while empowering and engaging our employees.
To be the leader of post-acute and rehabilitation care in the GCC, delivering exceptional patient experiences and clinical outcomes for patients from the region and beyond.

heading: Expanding Access to
Exceptional Care
expanding.lead: We continue to expand the Cambridge Hospital network across the UAE and the KSA as part of Cambridge Health Group’s commitment to advancing rehabilitation and extended care in the region.
text: As our network grows, we remain focused on expanding access to specialised care for patients requiring structured recovery pathways, long-term medical support and multidisciplinary rehabilitation, addressing the increasing demand for post-acute and long-term care services across both countries.

We are committed to delivering patient-centred care that enables individuals with serious injuries or illnesses to achieve meaningful improvements in their quality of life, supported by a comprehensive range of rehabilitation services.

Operating in alignment with internationally-recognised standards, we maintain a strong commitment to quality and patient safety, ensuring consistency and excellence in care delivery across all our locations.

As we continue to evolve, our focus remains on strengthening our role as a regional provider of rehabilitation, post-acute care and long-term care while maintaining our commitment to clinical excellence.
